scientific_integrity: Exact rational proofs independently enumerated in occupied-vertex and deposited-edge state spaces; no simulation or infinite extrapolation. Same-model review only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-graph result for GP(8,3) with independent edge-Poisson attempts, one eight-edge rate perturbation at a time, and local second-order response at homogeneous rates. No global optimum, general cubic-graph universality, or experimental validation is asserted. Unindexed specialized work and inaccessible full text of an early adsorption paper remain historical-priority risks.
title: Opposite second-order adsorption responses to ring and matching biases on the Möbius–Kantor graph
